name: 🏛 教务处
desc: 取号·填表·门户登录·盖章·邮寄·选课·成绩单·退课·截止日期·官方件

items.en: Please take a number and wait.
items.zh: 请取号后等候。

items.en: Fill out the transcript form.
items.zh: 请填写成绩单申请表。

items.en: The office opens at nine.
items.zh: 教务处九点开门。

items.en: Log into the portal now.
items.zh: 现在登录门户网站。

items.en: We will stamp your transcript.
items.zh: 我们会给成绩单盖章。

items.en: Course changes close on Friday.
items.zh: 选课变更周五截止。

items.en: Sign the form in ink.
items.zh: 请用签字笔签名。

items.en: Log into the portal to check your records.
items.zh: 登录门户网站查看你的档案。

items.en: We will stamp your transcript with our official seal.
items.zh: 我们会给成绩单加盖官方印章。

items.en: Your transcript will be mailed to your chosen schools.
items.zh: 你的成绩单将寄往你选择的学校。

items.en: Please take a number from the machine by the door.
items.zh: 请在门旁的机器上取号。

items.en: The deadline to add classes is next Monday.
items.zh: 加课的截止日期是下周一。

items.en: Official copies cost five dollars for each page.
items.zh: 官方件每页收费五美元。

items.en: Please bring a photo ID to pick up documents.
items.zh: 领取文件请携带带照片的证件。

items.en: If you need an unofficial copy, which you can keep for yourself, check this box.
items.zh: 如果你需要一份可自留的非官方副本，请勾选此框。
chunks: If you need an unofficial copy
which you can keep for yourself

items.en: Please email the office right away to fix issues such as missing courses.
items.zh: 如遇缺课等问题，请立即邮件联系教务处处理。
chunks: Please email the office right away

items.en: If you drop a course after the deadline, a withdrawal mark stays on your record.
items.zh: 如果你在截止日期后退课，退课标记会留在你的档案上。
chunks: If you drop a course after the deadline

items.en: Students who register late must pay a small extra fee before they can enroll.
items.zh: 逾期注册的学生须先缴一笔少量附加费才能选课。
chunks: must pay a small extra fee

items.en: When your form is complete, drop it in the box that is near the window.
items.zh: 表格填好后，把它投进靠窗的那个箱子里。

items.en: Because grades post at midnight, you should check the portal on Monday morning.
items.zh: 由于成绩午夜发布，你应在周一早上查看门户网站。

items.en: Any request that arrives after Friday will not be processed until the following week.
items.zh: 周五之后收到的任何申请要到下一周才会处理。
chunks: Any request that arrives after Friday
